description: Amazing views and light: our place is full floor with 360 views and 1770 sq ft. This is truly unique as most buildings are limited in size by law, so many apartments just face.. another apartment. We live on a hill, are on the top floor, and the ceiling height is ~10 ft. You are quite literally in the sky. Each window has a different view, with most major monuments (from Montmartre to Notre Dame) in sight. It is hard to overstate how nice it is to wake up and be suspended in the sky.
